title: Privacy Notice — Maharashtra Scheme Navigator

data_fiduciary.entity_name: Department of Information Technology, Government of Maharashtra

legal_framework: Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act), 2023
purpose_of_processing: Preliminary assessment of eligibility for public welfare schemes and grants
Pre-audit and verification of applicant eligibility documents
Guidance on official government application channels

retention_policy.automatic_deletion: Hourly automated purge job deletes temporary profiles, uploaded files, and session states.
retention_policy.audit_logs: Security audit logs retained for 180 days per CERT-In regulatory mandate.

citizen_rights: Right to access summary of processed personal data
Right to correction and erasure of incomplete or inaccurate data
Right of grievance redressal via POST /trust/report-issue
Right to nominate in case of death or incapacity
